In a landmark judgment, the nation’s highest court upheld a unanimous ruling by the NSW court of appeal that overturned MACH Energy’s proposed expansion of its Mount Pleasant coalmine in Musswellbrook. item.description: Allen Schnibben's interest in space started when he was a child. "I picked up some books about the solar system when I was in elementary school.
